meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES per night for a family of 2 adults + up to 3 children at standard rates. Holiday/school-holiday pricing will be higher. Always verify on the official website.

properties.name: Rydges South Bank Brisbane
properties.description: Modern hotel directly opposite South Bank Parklands — outdoor pool, family rooms with 2 queen beds, 24-hour room service, close to Queensland Museum, GOMA, and the Wheel of Brisbane. Walk to everything.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting to be at the heart of South Bank culture and parklands — walk to museums, play areas and restaurants.

properties.name: Mantra South Bank Brisbane
properties.description: Apartment hotel on South Bank — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments with full kitchens, outdoor pool, walk to South Bank Parklands, Brisbane River, and cultural precinct. Great for longer Brisbane stays.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting apartment living at South Bank — full kitchen means you self-cater near the parklands.

properties.name: W Brisbane
properties.description: Luxury lifestyle hotel on the Brisbane River — WET Deck pool, AWAY Spa, multiple restaurants (Three Blue Ducks), kids' welcome pack, stylish family rooms with river views. Part of the new North Quay precinct.
properties.bestFor: Families who want luxury in the CBD with a resort-style pool deck and unbeatable river views.

properties.name: Novotel Brisbane South Bank
properties.description: Modern 4-star hotel steps from South Bank — rooftop pool, restaurant, bar, family rooms, kids stay and eat free (conditions apply). Walking distance to parklands, Cultural Centre, and Grey Street dining.
properties.bestFor: A straightforward, affordable family base in South Brisbane — kids eat free and the parklands are at your door.

properties.name: Oaks Brisbane 212 Margaret Suites
properties.description: Value apartment hotel in the CBD — spacious 1 & 2 bedroom apartments with full kitchens and laundries, outdoor pool and gym. Walk to Queen Street Mall, Botanic Gardens, and the River.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting CBD convenience at apartment prices — full kitchen and laundry on a budget.

properties.name: The Johnson Brisbane — Art Series
properties.description: Design hotel in Spring Hill on the CBD doorstep — one of Brisbane's biggest hotel pools (50m lap pool), studio and one-bed apartment options, art-filled interiors.
properties.bestFor: Creative families who want something different — colourful art-filled spaces and a rooftop pool in the CBD.

properties.name: Riverside Hotel South Bank
properties.description: Affordable apartment hotel near South Bank — 1 & 2 bedroom self-contained apartments, walk to South Bank Parklands, Cultural Centre, and Brisbane River. Simple, clean, great value.
properties.bestFor: Families watching every dollar near South Bank — self-contained apartments within walking distance of everything.

properties.name: Pan Pacific Brisbane
properties.description: Luxury hotel overlooking the Botanic Gardens and the river — outdoor pool, day spa, acclaimed restaurant (The Dior), spacious suites with kitchenettes. Premium family experience in the heart of the city.
properties.bestFor: Families celebrating a special occasion — luxury with Botanic Gardens views and walking distance to everything.

properties.name: Hilton Brisbane
properties.description: Iconic Brisbane hotel in Queen Street Mall — heated outdoor pool, Vintaged Bar & Grill, executive lounge, family rooms, connected to the Myer Centre. Central, luxurious, and reliable.
properties.bestFor: Families who want to be in the absolute centre of Brisbane — Queen Street Mall, dining, and shopping at your feet.

properties.name: Link Portside Wharf Apartment Hotel
properties.description: Waterfront apartments at Hamilton's Portside Wharf — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom luxury apartments with river views, rooftop pool, walk to Eat Street Northshore markets, cruise terminal, and riverside dining. Premium location.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting a riverfront base near Eat Street Northshore — self-contained luxury with easy access to the markets and cruises.

properties.name: The Calile Hotel
properties.description: Brisbane’s famous resort-in-the-city on James Street — palm-fringed pool deck with cabanas, luxe rooms, and the Valley’s best shopping and dining downstairs.
properties.bestFor: A genuine 5-star resort feel without leaving the city.

properties.name: Emporium Hotel South Bank
properties.description: Luxury boutique tower overlooking South Bank parklands — rooftop infinity pool with river views, opulent rooms, and Streets Beach a 5-minute walk away.
properties.bestFor: Rooftop-pool luxury right beside Brisbane’s best free family precinct.

properties.name: Oaks Brisbane on Charlotte
properties.description: Self-contained CBD apartments with full kitchens and laundry — indoor lap pool, walking distance to Queen Street Mall, botanic gardens and the river.
properties.bestFor: Apartment value in the middle of the city.

properties.name: The Star Grand Brisbane
properties.description: Brisbane’s newest luxury hotel at Queen’s Wharf — infinity pool on the Sky Deck, river views, and the city’s biggest dining precinct downstairs.
properties.bestFor: New-build luxury with the best pool deck in the city.

properties.name: Adina Apartment Hotel Brisbane
properties.description: Heritage-facade apartment hotel near Anzac Square — kitchenettes and full kitchens, indoor pool, and Central Station two blocks away for airport and Gold Coast trains.
properties.bestFor: Kitchen convenience near the train line.

properties.name: Quest South Brisbane
properties.description: Serviced apartments a short walk from South Bank parklands and Streets Beach — full kitchens and laundries, rooftop pool and BBQ area, and easy access to the cultural precinct.
properties.bestFor: Budget apartment base walkable to everything at South Bank.

properties.name: Ovolo The Valley
properties.description: Playful designer hotel in Fortitude Valley — outdoor pool, free minibar and perks included, wild colourful interiors kids find hilarious, James Street shopping nearby.
properties.bestFor: A fun, quirky stay with freebies included.
